Class JwtExtractorProperties

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.audit.JwtExtractorProperties
public class JwtExtractorProperties extends Object
Where to find the claims in an access token. The mechanism is not tied to any audit format: the defaults simply point at the standard JWT claims and at the IHE IUA and BPPC extensions.
